reason: Resolve the interaction between amendment 012's explicit event-panel capture limitation and amendment 014's capture gate before any HOLDOUT access.

capture_gate_semantics.supported_capture_model: If amendment-012 capture models are supported, capture-only loss minus selected-plus-capture loss must be > 0. A nonpositive or nonfinite result receives CAPTURE_CONFOUNDED.
capture_gate_semantics.unsupported_capture_model: If amendment-012 explicitly marks the capture comparator unsupported because the frozen panel lacks raw capture controls, do not invent a proxy and do not automatically fail the candidate. Record capture_test_supported=false and rely on the preregistered source-version, continuity, delayed/time-shift, activity and other supported falsifications.
capture_gate_semantics.event_panels: The four frozen event-time coordinates have no raw capture-control comparator by construction and therefore use the unsupported rule above.
capture_gate_semantics.no_post_holdout_choice: This rule is fixed before any HOLDOUT kernel is submitted.
